name: h3_htvx fairing
note: Launch vehicle render model (tools/make_rocket_models.py), h3_htvx: fairing. Body frame: +Z toward the nose, origin at the aft end; engine bells below it. Core / upper split, SRB nose and fairing lengths estimated from photographs. One fairing half (the other is it turned 180 deg about +Z), in the stage's frame: separated, it falls away tumbling.

sources.subject: attitude
sources.value: +Z along the thrust axis (the sim passes it as 'velocity'), -Y (the ship's heat shield) down
sources.source: A rocket flies along its thrust axis; a gravity turn and an entry fly belly down.

sources.value: diameters and lengths rounded from the references; shapes (ogives, flaps, tapers) estimated from photographs
sources.source: JAXA H3 Launch Vehicle pages / Wikipedia 'H3 (rocket)': 5.2 m core, 2 LE-9 on the '24' configuration, four SRB-3 (2.5 m x 14.6 m), LE-5B-3 second stage, 5.2 m 'W' fairing (long), ~63 m | JAXA HTV-X: launched on H3-24W from Tanegashima (HTV-X1, 2025-10-26)

sources.value: white: white paint (operator liveries in launch photographs); grey: grey paint (Soyuz, Long March detail)
sources.source: Liveries from photographs; reflectance from the presets.
